sentences.en: In any industry a reputation can make or break people.
sentences.zh: 在任何行业中，声誉都能决定一个人的成败。

sentences.en: The laboratory acquired a fabulous reputation for its historic discovery.
sentences.zh: 这家实验室因其历史性的发现而获得了极好的声誉。

sentences.en: The successful concert tour established her reputation as a singer.
sentences.zh: 成功的巡演确立了她歌手的身份。
